allow: PowerShell(Write-Output '--- docker ---'; \(Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) | Select-Object Source; Write-Output '--- winget ---'; \(Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) | Select-Object Source; Write-Output '--- choco ---'; \(Get-Command choco -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) | Select-Object Source; Write-Output '--- scoop ---'; \(Get-Command scoop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) | Select-Object Source; Write-Output '--- existing pg_dump anywhere ---'; Get-ChildItem -Path 'C:\\Program Files\\PostgreSQL' -Filter pg_dump.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName)

PowerShell($tools = @\('docker','winget','choco','scoop','pg_dump'\); foreach \($t in $tools\) { $cmd = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($cmd\) { Write-Output "$t : FOUND at $\($cmd.Source\)" } else { Write-Output "$t : not found" } }; Write-Output '--- search PostgreSQL install dirs ---'; @\('C:\\Program Files\\PostgreSQL', 'C:\\Program Files \(x86\)\\PostgreSQL'\) | ForEach-Object { if \(Test-Path $_\) { Get-ChildItem $_ -Filter pg_dump.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName } })

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5029 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalPort, State, OwningProcess; if \(-not \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5029 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\)\) { Write-Output 'Port 5029 is FREE' })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5029' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Output \('HTTP ' + $r.StatusCode + ' - ' + $r.Content.Length + ' bytes'\); Write-Output '--- first 400 chars ---'; $r.Content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(400, $r.Content.Length\)\) } catch { Write-Output \('ERROR: ' + $_.Exception.Message\) })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5029/login' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Output \('HTTP ' + $r.StatusCode + ' - ' + $r.Content.Length + ' bytes'\); $hasRBCont = $r.Content -match 'RBCont'; $hasTurbo = $r.Content -match 'Turbo'; Write-Output \('contains RBCont? ' + $hasRBCont\); Write-Output \('contains Turbo? ' + $hasTurbo\) } catch { Write-Output \('ERROR: ' + $_.Exception.Message\) })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5029/login' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Output \('HTTP ' + $r.StatusCode\); $c = $r.Content; $banned = @\('time interno','corporativo','uso interno','Acesso restrito','time de suporte L1'\) ; foreach \($t in $banned\) { if \($c -match $t\) { Write-Output \('STILL PRESENT: ' + $t\) } }; Write-Output 'Done.' } catch { Write-Output \('ERROR: ' + $_.Exception.Message\) })

PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime, @{N='CmdLine';E={\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $\($_.Id\)"\).CommandLine}} | Format-Table -Wrap)

PowerShell(Stop-Process -Id 5800,26740,32224 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Id -in 5800,26740,32224 } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output \('STILL ALIVE: ' + $_.Id\) }; Write-Output 'cleanup done')

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5029/login' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Output \('HTTP ' + $r.StatusCode + ' - ' + $r.Content.Length + ' bytes - rebrand intact: ' + \($r.Content -match 'RBCont'\)\) } catch { Write-Output \('ERROR: ' + $_.Exception.Message\) })
